moves.text: David Njoku is healthy but still on IR. He can't score until you move him back to your roster.
Offer Achane Saw Massacre: Tank Dell for Geno Smith.

reasons: You're 7-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 16%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 10 contenders (151.3 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 16%, 22%, 24%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 16% to 19%, and your lineup comes out 0.6 points a week ahead overall. Tank Dell adds 0.0 points a week for you today, but Geno Smith is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 1,534, get 1,604), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.4 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 22% and 24% to 22% and 23%.
You have 4 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 14 is your weakest projected week (157 points vs your usual 184), mostly byes.
Rhamondre Stevenson may be worth more now than later: age 28: RB values usually drop after this season.
Tank Dell may be worth more now than later: value 1,534 vs ~847 for 7.0 pts/wk of production.
Jayden Daniels's trade value has dropped 13% in 25 days.
Lamar Jackson's trade value has dropped 24% in 25 days.
